## Change

Describe the template/plugin behavior and the reason for the change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes using synthetic data.
- [ ] Relevant source and production-export behavior was exercised.
- [ ] UI changes were checked on narrow screens and with a keyboard.
- [ ] Inputs/output, routes, CSRF/revisions and recovery remain safe.
- [ ] No credentials, runtime content, uploads or proprietary material are included.
- [ ] Applicable licenses/notices are preserved; template/plugin guides were updated if needed.
